_: One glyph, one meaning. The prose version is in design.md under 'One glyph, one meaning';
this is the machine-readable copy that bin/design/icon-audit.js and
spec/system/button_icons_system_spec.rb check the app against. Change both together.
Adding a glyph here is how you add one to the app: the audit fails on any glyph it does not
find, so a one-off has to be a decision rather than a reflex. That is the whole point --
'Invite user' carried three different glyphs on three pages because nothing said otherwise.
